endpoints.sideEffects: Aborts the in-flight task via AbortController; does not rewrite history
Clears chat/logs/cache/reports by scope; never touches long-term memory, knowledge base or user files
Marks an inbox message as processed (persisted)
Hot-updates LLM settings and writes config.json (contains apiKey)
Outbound call to the provider API to list models (uses apiKey)
Writes config.json locale and rebuilds the palette UI
Deletes the whole project directory (destructive); falls back to global scope if it was active
Creates a project directory and switches to it (disk write)
Pushes a message to the palette UI
Appends a reply into the queue/history (used by external drivers)
Graceful exit; launcher restarts in ~3s (short disconnect)
Starts one LLM turn (writes history, may call CAD); abortable via /cancel
Passes JSON-RPC through to the plugin on :8080 - the AI main channel, can run any registered method

Writes an exported workflow artifact (json / markdown) to a user-chosen path; POST .../replay dry-run only re-runs read-only steps; POST .../replay assisted opens an in-memory step-by-step session (nothing executes until the caller approves each tier B/C step, handles are remapped from earlier steps of the same run, sessions expire after 30 min). POST .../bind validates slot values and returns a preview (no execution, nothing written).
Moves workflow record files into <scope>/_trash/ (recoverable, never unlinks). Body {ids?:[...]}; empty ids clears the whole current scope.
